title: Stack-trace disclosure via ShowExceptions enabled by default
description: Verified: server.psd1:24 sets Web.ErrorPages.ShowExceptions = $true and server.psd1:39 sets Podex.Debug = $true. With both defaults on, internal exception messages and stack traces are returned to clients, disclosing file paths and implementation details.
notes: Coupling: edits server.psd1 defaults (Web.ErrorPages.ShowExceptions at server.psd1:24 and Podex.Debug at server.psd1:39) shared with audit-codebase-analysis-1783691796-unauth-debug-routes and remediation-20260710-debug-hotpath-writes. All three pivot on the Podex.Debug=$true default; coordinate so the server.psd1 change is made once, consistently. | Added by feature-review 2026-07-10. | RESOLVED 2026-07-10: Set Web.ErrorPages.ShowExceptions = $false in server.psd1 (documented as safe default with an explicit local-dev-only opt-in comment, mirroring the already-$false Podex.Debug posture set by the coupled unauth-debug-routes fix). With ShowExceptions off, Pode's Responses.ps1 no longer populates $data.exception, so uncaught errors render the generic errors/default.html.pode page (no exception message/stack trace) while full details are still captured server-side via Enable-PodeErrorLogging. Added a 'Security-posture config defaults' Describe to tests/pantry.Tests.ps1 that Import-PowerShellDataFile-loads server.psd1 and asserts ShowExceptions=$false, Podex.Debug=$false, and that errors/default.html.pode exists. Verification: npm test 70 passed / 0 failed (+3); npm run format clean; lint errors confined to vendored public/js/mustache.js; PSScriptAnalyzer adds no new findings.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. Default Web.ErrorPages.ShowExceptions to $false in server.psd1.
2. Serve generic error pages (errors/default.html.pode already exists) to clients while logging full details server-side.
3. Only enable exception disclosure behind an explicit local-dev override.
